name: Thalia
aliases: Thalia of the Order of Saint Traft
description: Thalia is a Knight-Cathar from Gavony who became Guardian of Thraben and later led the Order of Saint Traft on Innistrad.

summary.text: Thalia is a Knight-Cathar from Gavony who became Guardian of Thraben and later led the Order of Saint Traft on Innistrad.

citations.text: "Thalia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Thalia rose to become one of Lothar's elite and took the oath never to let the Helvault come to harm, and she became Guardian of Thraben, unknowingly keeping Avacyn sealed.

citations.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citations.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

citations.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citations.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

citations.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citations.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: During the siege of Thraben she burned the outer ring and halted the undead.

citations.text: "Siege of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Liliana Vess then threatened Thalia's soldiers and forced her to destroy the Helvault, freeing Avacyn and the demons.

citations.text: "Thalia", section "The Sundering of the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Thalia", section "The Sundering of the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: When Avacyn turned against humans, Thalia left the corrupted church and founded the Order of Saint Traft with Saint Traft's geist, after the Lunarch Council stripped her title and condemned her, and she escaped with Odric and Grete.

citations.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Traft", section "Eldritch Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.
"The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.
"The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

bio.text: After Avacyn's death Rem Karolus gave her Avacyn's spear, and at the Battle of Thraben she fought Eldrazi, allied temporarily with Olivia Voldaren, and with Sigarda's help killed Brisela.

citations.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citations.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citations.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.
"Traft", section "Eldritch Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Emrakul's presence forced Saint Traft out of her, nearly driving her mad.

citations.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She survived the Travails and vowed to restore Thraben, fighting beside Odric when Henrika Domnathi's vampires attacked and Odric was turned.

citations.text: "Thalia", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.
"The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

bio.text: In the Phyrexian invasion the Gitrog Monster rescued her, and she began working with Arlinn Kord to set up defenses across Innistrad.

citations.text: "Thalia", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Thalia", section "Omenpath Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: As of the latest main story Thalia is alive, working with Arlinn Kord on Innistrad's defenses, while a later Echoverse spirit of her, killed on Avacyn's order, protects her cathedral.

citations.text: "Thalia", section "Omenpath Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
"The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault, freeing Avacyn.
timeline.quote: She forced the cathar Thalia to destroy the silver Helvault , where Avacyn was held, to reach one of her enemies .

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia chooses to save her men, causing the Sundering of the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Thalia chose to save her men, allowing the Sundering of the Helvault to take place.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Lothar dies in the Siege of Thraben, Thalia becomes Guardian of Thraben.
timeline.quote: Thalia became the Guardian of Thraben in her predecessor's stead.

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Rise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia orders others to grab axes and defend the gate against despair.
timeline.quote: Grab an axe and defend the gate!

citation.text: Burden of Guilt (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thalia declares she will not see Thraben fall to the unhallowed horde.
timeline.quote: Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde.

citation.text: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Constable Visil confesses to Thalia his fear of what comes after death, and Thalia reassures him of Avacyn's protection.
timeline.quote: Your soul is protected by the hand of Avacyn and will never submit to evil.

citation.text: Unhallowed Cathar (Dark Ascension, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Order of Saint Traft forms shortly before the Battle of Thraben.
timeline.quote: The Order of Saint Traft came into being during the last part of the Travails , shortly before the Battle of Thraben .

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Geralf and Gisa besiege Thraben; Mikaeus appoints Thalia supreme commander after Luthor is found dead.
timeline.quote: he appointed Thalia as the supreme commander of the city's forces

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Undead Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bishop Alwin decrees Mikaeus be interred secretly to protect faith.
timeline.quote: decreed that Mikaeus would be interred into the tomb of the Lunarchs unceremoniously

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Unhallowed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault by threatening her soldiers, unleashing Avacyn and the demons.
timeline.quote: she forced Thalia to do so by threatening the lives of her soldiers

citation.text: "Thalia", section "The Sundering of the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia charges into a howlpack of Krallenhorde werewolves to rescue a single old man, impressing Lothar, who makes her one of his elite guardians.
timeline.quote: Lothar made her part of his elite guardians that very day.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thalia takes the oath to never allow the Helvault to come to harm.
timeline.quote: Thalia took the same oath that Lothar swore

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thalia traps the undead hordes with straw and burns them in a great circle of fire.
timeline.quote: She outwitted the ghouls and skaabs, burning them to ash in a great circle of fire

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thalia becomes the Guardian of Thraben, unknowingly keeping Avacyn sealed.
timeline.quote: Thalia took charge of the elite guardians of Thraben, becoming the Guardian of Thraben in her predecessor's stead.

citation.work: The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel
citation.text: "The Guardian, the Witch, and the Angel". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thalia states that Avacyn's freedom came at the price of Griselbrand.
timeline.quote: Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price

citation.text: Griselbrand (Avacyn Restored, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess forces Thalia to open the Helvault, releasing the demons and Avacyn.
timeline.quote: This resulted in the release of both the demons and Avacyn

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess threatened Thalia, leading to the sundering of the Helvault and the release of Avacyn and the demons.
timeline.quote: With the sundering of the Helvault , both Avacyn and the demons were unleashed back into the world.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Destruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault during the siege of Thraben, releasing the demons and Avacyn.
timeline.quote: With the sundering of the Helvault , both the demons and Avacyn were released

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Avacyn's return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben Sigarda fights the corrupted angels with Thalia.
timeline.quote: aiding the Cathar Thalia in slaying the monstrosity that was comprised of her former sisters

citation.text: "Sigarda", section "Survivor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana coerces Thalia into letting her shatter the Helvault, and it bursts apart, freeing everything inside.
timeline.quote: Thalia chose to save her people and allow Liliana to break open the Helvault.

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia agrees to a truce with Thalia at Thraben and kills Seeta in front of her.
timeline.quote: Olivia killed Seeta - the Leader of the Sinpurged, right in front of Thalia.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, affected by madness, turns against humans; Thalia leaves the corrupted church and founds the Order of Saint Traft.
timeline.quote: Thalia left and created the Order of Saint Traft to battle evil

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rem Karolus gifts Thalia the spear of the deceased Avacyn.
timeline.quote: Rem Karolus gifted her with the spear of the deceased Avacyn.

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben, empowered by Traft's geist, Thalia fights Eldrazi; Sigarda rescues her from Brisela and they defeat the fused sisters.
timeline.quote: Together, Thalia and Sigardia bested the fused sisters.

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's presence forces Saint Traft out of Thalia, nearly driving her mad.
timeline.quote: forced Saint Traft to leave Thalia's body

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia rides to Thraben Cathedral, furious after witnessing atrocities at Elgaud.
timeline.quote: The ride from the Elgaud Grounds in Nephalia to Thraben Cathedral had taken days

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia confronts Odric, demanding he stop the inquisition's burning of children at Elgaud.
timeline.quote: We're burning children now.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric defends the purge, saying Avacyn is leading it and the church must follow her example.
timeline.quote: Avacyn is leading this purge.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia confides her doubt that Avacyn was corrupted by her time in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: What if her time in the Helvault corrupted her?

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia declares she can no longer serve Avacyn and her church.
timeline.quote: I can no longer serve Avacyn and her church.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric urges Thalia to leave Thraben and has Grete escort her beyond the wall.
timeline.quote: Will you please escort Thalia beyond the outer wall?

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia tells Grete she will fight, even against the angels if she must.
timeline.quote: I'm going to fight,

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Weeks later Thalia bursts into the Lunarch Council, where Odric tells her the council has removed her title; she realizes he informed the council of her heresy.
timeline.quote: The council has removed it from you.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia accuses Bishop Jerren of communion with Ormendahl and of leading the Skirsdag.
timeline.quote: I bring evidence that you have been in communion with the demon Ormendahl, called the Profane Prince, and you are now the leader of the Skirsdag.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia recounts finding a witch eating a messenger's heart in Wittal parish and killing her (recounted).
timeline.quote: Rushing inside, we found the witch lifting the quivering heart from the corpse of a messenger

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia presents a bloodstained letter bearing Jerren's seal giving instructions to the witch in the Profane Prince's name.
timeline.quote: The letter bears the seal and signature of none other than Bishop Jerren, giving instructions to this witch in the name of the Profane Prince!

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Several bishops refuse the letter until Carlin takes it and pales as she reads.
timeline.quote: Three bishops refused her as the council sat in stony silence, before Bishop Carlin took it with a quivering hand.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: The council calls for Thalia's execution and cathars seize her on Jerren's signal.
timeline.quote: Cathars came and seized Thalia's arms before she could draw it, looking to Jerren for direction.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric, shaken by the council's cruelty, goes to Thalia's cell and tells the guard to open it, planning to leave with her.
timeline.quote: We are leaving here, together.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Dougan and other cathars block Odric, Thalia and Grete at the stables on Jerren's orders.
timeline.quote: Stop where you stand, Lunarch Marshal,

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: The three escape the cathedral and leave Thraben on horseback.
timeline.quote: And they left the cathedral, then left Thraben, left their old lives far behind.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia welcomes Grete to the Order of Saint Traft in a small Nearheath chapel.
timeline.quote: Welcome to the Order of Saint Traft,

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: The holy geist of Saint Traft appears beside Thalia.
timeline.quote: radiant but insubstantial, a holy geist.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Grete kneels and pledges to follow Thalia.
timeline.quote: Wherever you lead.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia recalls being forced to kill her scout Halmig, who rejoined the march changed and squirming.
timeline.quote: She had been forced to kill him, or whatever he had become

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia's party meets Rem Karolus, who carries Avacyn's broken spear and confirms she is dead.
timeline.quote: Even with its tip broken in a jagged line, Avacyn's spear was unmistakable.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia's hand is burned by holy light when she tries to touch the spear.
timeline.quote: A flare of holy light erupted where her hand touched the metal haft

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: With Saint Traft's power, Thalia lifts the spear and mounts it on her saddle as the order's banner.
timeline.quote: We ride under this banner now,

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia shows her army the spear and tells them Avacyn is gone, urging them to be their own light.
timeline.quote: For the memory of Avacyn, of the light and goodness that have fled from the world, we fight!

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: A monster fused from a horse and rider attacks Thalia, numbing her face before her gryff and cathars kill it.
timeline.quote: But then she strayed too close to a shambling thing the size of a large horse, and it wheeled on her.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Dennias is overtaken by magenta tendrils from his body and Thalia kills him mercifully.
timeline.quote: Her blade took his life quickly

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren parleys with Thalia in midair, offering common cause against the horrors.
timeline.quote: I'm Olivia Voldaren, lady of Lurenbraum and progenitor of the Voldaren line.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia and Olivia agree that vampires and humans will not harm each other until the fight is over.
timeline.quote: No vampire bite or blade will draw human blood until this fight is through, Heir of Saint Traft.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Thalia meets the geist of Saint Traft in an ancient chapel and takes him in.
timeline.quote: Will you take me in?

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia calls on Saint Traft to summon the spirits of the dead, who possess and shield her soldiers.
timeline.quote: It was Traft who called them, and they answered his summons.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia declines to force possession on those who cannot accept the spirits.
timeline.quote: I can't make that choice for them.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia's army passes through Thraben's Outer Wall and fights alongside vampires through the streets.
timeline.quote: They were fighting shoulder to shoulder with vampires now, making their way through the streets of the city.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: A huge fused angel of flesh, tentacles and feathered wings looms before Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: Drifting in the air in front of the cathedral was a huge abomination formed of twisted flesh, writhing tentacles...and feathered wings.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia attacks the angel-thing on her gryff and is slashed down, her gryff killed.
timeline.quote: In response, the angel brought its other arm up and slashed a half-dozen finger-claws down her side and across her gryff's flank

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sigarda arrives and disowns her fused sisters.
timeline.quote: You are no longer my sisters,

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: With Saint Traft's help, Thalia lifts Avacyn's spear and is given glowing angelic wings.
timeline.quote: glowing, translucent wings spread out from her back, the blessing of some unseen angel.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia drives Avacyn's spear through the angel-thing's back and into its spine.
timeline.quote: she drove Avacyn's spear through feathered wings and buried it deep into the spine

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sigarda bursts from the dying angel-thing's chest, and the creature falls dead, calling her sister.
timeline.quote: And it followed Sigarda to the hard stone of the plaza below, curling like a dead spider on the ground.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: A vast tentacled thing approaches Thraben as a tidal wave of corrupted monsters smashes into the plaza.
timeline.quote: As it approached, a tidal wave of corrupted monstrosities crested before it, smashing into the plaza and turning the tide once more toward annihilation.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia says holy places are no longer sanctuary from death.
timeline.quote: Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything.

citation.text: Blasphemous Act (Commander 2016, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In the Battle of Thraben a coalition of vampires, the Order of Saint Traft, the Gatewatch and zombies defeat Emrakul's Eldrazi and Nahiri's cultists after Sigarda kills Brisela; Emrakul is imprisoned in Innistrad's Moon.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was imprisoned within Innistrad's Moon

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia, Odric and the cathars refuse to abandon the ruined city and keep waging war on the zombies.
timeline.quote: still wage war on the zombies that prowl the streets

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia's letter, read to Odric, tells of Avacyn's death, the fall of the archangels and a stronger evil that forced Saint Traft out of her.
timeline.quote: She is dead, too.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Odric mourns in the chapel, regretting not believing Thalia about the Lunarch Council's corruption.
timeline.quote: Thalia had warned him of the Lunarch Council's corruption

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Thalia crashes through the roof and kills cathar attackers alongside Odric.
timeline.quote: Thalia came down along with her and landed hard

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Twenty Domnathi vampires overrun Odric and Thalia.
timeline.quote: Soon they were disarmed, overwhelmed, and held at the mercy of Henrika's minions.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Henrika slits the throat of the glamered father and demands that Thalia serve; Thalia refuses.
timeline.quote: Henrika slit the throat of the father.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Odric leaps in front of Henrika's sword to save Thalia and is mortally wounded.
timeline.quote: He leaped in front of the sword moments before it was to take Thalia's hand

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The Domnathi vampires explode because of the blessed water in Odric's blood; Thalia stabs Henrika, who flees as mist.
timeline.quote: "There is blessed water in your blood—?!"

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The vampiric Odric hurls his sword to behead the priest and break the pool, and the demon Ormendahl sinks back into oblivion.
timeline.quote: The blade severed the priest's head and lodged in the bowl of the pool.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Odric finds that, as a vampire, he can still see the moon and feels peace; he and Thalia stand together.
timeline.quote: "Yes, I can see it."

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Thalia vows not to rest until Thraben is cleansed.
timeline.quote: I will not rest until it is cleansed.

citation.text: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thalia says creatures of night dissolve in faith's light.
timeline.quote: Creatures of the night dissolve like shadows in the light of faith.

citation.text: Piercing Light (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thalia states that Olivia has faith only in herself.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren has faith only in herself. We answer to a higher calling.

citation.text: Sanctify (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thalia survives the Travails, vows to restore Thraben, and sees Henrika turn Odric into a vampire.
timeline.quote: turned Odric into a vampire

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caught scavenging in besieged Thraben, Torens is spared by Odric and made Mausoleum Guard by Thalia.
timeline.quote: Thalia put Torens to work as Mausoleum Guard .

citation.text: "Torens", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia marshals cathars, townspeople, and ghoulcallers into a fighting force to defend Thraben.
timeline.quote: No stranger to monstrous foes, Thalia marshaled surviving cathars, townspeople, and even ghoulcallers into an unbreakable fighting force.

citation.text: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben (Multiverse Legends, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion strikes; Gisa and Geralf defeat a force at Havengul and Innistrad's zombies prove immune to phyresis.
timeline.quote: Gisa and Geralf Cecani defeated a powerful Phyrexian invasion force attacking Havengul

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gitrog Monster saves Thalia from Phyrexians and lets her ride it into battle.
timeline.quote: the Gitrog Monster bowled through her besiegers, saving her

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After losing many of her order, Thalia begins working with Arlinn Kord to set up defenses across Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Thalia began working with Arlinn Kord to set up defenses all over the plane

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Omenpath Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn orders Odric to kill Thalia after she abandons the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Avacyn ordered Odric, Thalia's longtime comrade, to kill Thalia.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vampires, angels, humans and planeswalkers unite at Thraben against Emrakul and Nahiri's cultists.
timeline.quote: Together, they formed a coalition to resist the Eldrazi and the cultists loyal to Nahiri.

citation.text: "Battle of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gitrog Monster rescues Thalia from Phyrexians at Thraben and lets her ride it.
timeline.quote: the Gitrog Monster bowled through her besiegers, saving her

citation.text: "Gitrog monster", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces the Sundering of the Helvault by pressuring Thalia, freeing Griselbrand.
timeline.quote: she forced the Sundering of the Helvault by forcing an ultimatum on Thalia, its guardian

citation.text: "Griselbrand", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Council is exposed as Skirsdag-controlled, Odric and Grete flee the Church and join Thalia's Order of Saint Traft.
timeline.quote: Odric and Grete fled the Church and joined Thalia as part of the Order of Saint Traft .

citation.text: "Odric", section "Rebel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Odric throws himself before a blade meant for Thalia, saving her but dooming himself, and is bitten by Henrika.
timeline.quote: he interrupted the ritual by throwing himself before a blade meant for his ally, saving her but dooming himself.

citation.text: "Odric", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Odric, now a vampire, finds the moon brings him peace and his faith restored.
timeline.quote: Ironically, his transformation had restored his shaken faith.

citation.text: "Odric", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Avacyn's death Karolus brings her spear to Thalia and the Order of Saint Traft.
timeline.quote: After Avacyn 's death, he brought her spear to Thalia and the Order of Saint Traft .

citation.text: "Rem Karolus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia burns the outer ring using stolen thatch, incinerating the undead and halting the siege.
timeline.quote: Thalia set the outer ring ablaze using stolen thatch from Thraben’s rooftops

citation.text: "Siege of Thraben", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia leaves the infiltrated church and creates the Order of Saint Traft with Traft's geist.
timeline.quote: created the Order of Saint Traft to battle evil

citation.text: "Traft", section "Eldritch Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Battle of Thraben Traft possesses Thalia to protect her and fight the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Traft possessed Thalia to protect her from Emrakul 's madness

citation.text: "Traft", section "Eldritch Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia kills Brisela with Avacyn's spear and Sigarda's help.
timeline.quote: Brisela was killed by Thalia

citation.text: "Traft", section "Eldritch Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
